summary_1line: Garuda carries the enslaved Vinata and the snakes toward the sun, scorching them, prompting Kadru to pray to Indra for protective rain.

image_candidates.scene_text: Garuda soars toward the blazing Sun carrying the serpents on his back while the snakes writhe and faint under the scorching rays.
Vinata humbly bears Kadru on her shoulders across the ocean shore while Garuda waits nearby with the serpents.
Kadru raises her hands in fervent prayer to Indra as her serpent sons lie scorched beneath the blazing sky.
